Alluvial.description: Formed by river silt deposits; fertile, loamy to sandy loam, ideal for cereals, sugarcane, potatoes.
Alluvial.recommended_amendments: Zinc sulphate (25 kg/ha) every 2 years; regular organic manure to maintain active humus.

Black Cotton (Vertisol).description: High montmorillonite clay content; deep swelling and shrinking cracks, rich in Ca and Mg, high water retention.
Black Cotton (Vertisol).recommended_amendments: Broad bed furrow planting to prevent waterlogging; apply elemental Sulphur and Farmyard Manure (FYM).

Red Sandy Loam.description: Formed from crystalline granite rocks; porous, gravelly, low organic matter, responds well to drip irrigation.
Red Sandy Loam.recommended_amendments: Heavy green manuring with Sunhemp/Dhaincha; lime application if pH falls below 5.8.

Laterite.description: Formed under intense tropical weathering with heavy rainfall; rich in iron and aluminum oxides, acidic.
Laterite.recommended_amendments: Agricultural lime or dolomite (2-3 tons/ha) to neutralize toxic aluminum; rock phosphate with PSB.

Clay Loam.description: Balanced soil with approx 30% clay, 40% silt, 30% sand; excellent nutrient retention and moderate drainage.
Clay Loam.recommended_amendments: Vermicompost dosing (2 tons/acre) and minimum tillage to preserve soil aggregate stability.

Sandy Loam.description: Light, warm, fast-draining soil; low natural fertility but responds dramatically to precision fertigation.
Sandy Loam.recommended_amendments: Frequent split applications of water-soluble fertilizers; heavy biochar and mulching to retain moisture.

Desert Sandy.description: Arid aeolian sand with low water holding capacity; prone to wind erosion; requires drip irrigation.
Desert Sandy.recommended_amendments: Hydrogel polymers, shelterbelt tree windbreaks (Khejri, Neem), drip irrigation mandatory.

Peaty / Marshy.description: Formed under anaerobic submerged conditions; very high organic matter (>15%), often acidic with blue-grey iron.
Peaty / Marshy.recommended_amendments: Drainage channels, sub-surface tile drains, copper and zinc supplementation, liming.

Saline / Alkaline.description: High soluble salts or exchangeable sodium percentage (ESP > 15%); poor physical structure, dispersion.
Saline / Alkaline.recommended_amendments: Gypsum requirement calculation: apply mineral Gypsum (4-8 tons/ha), flush with fresh water, grow Dhaincha.
